data.one_liner: Horizontal calendar UI kit for Flutter with agendas, timelines, and month grids.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive calendar UI kit featuring horizontal weekly strips, date carousels, month grids, timelines, foldables, and streak trackers. Built on a robust date engine designed to handle timezones and civil dates correctly across all platforms.
use_when: You need a horizontal weekly calendar or week strip in your Flutter app.
Your UI requires date pickers, agendas, timelines, or foldable month views.
You need reliable date calculations that handle daylight saving and tricky timezones.
avoid_when: You only need a basic built-in Material date picker.
You do not want any custom calendar UI elements in your app.
strengths: Extensive suite of calendar surfaces and widgets (strip, carousel, timeline, foldable, agenda, heatmap).
Precise timezone and leap-year handling using integer day numbers.
Supports home-screen widgets for Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Native home-screen widgets require manual setup and platform configuration outside of Dart.
Large API surface with many specialized configuration options.
data.setup_notes: Dart dependencies are straightforward, but setting up native home-screen widgets requires configuring Android RemoteViews and iOS WidgetKit targets with App Group identifiers.
